best_match.fbbt_definition: For image, see FBrf0211729. Adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron from the ad neuroblast (ALad1) lineage whose dendrites mainly innervate antennal lobe glomerulus DL1. This is the first cell type to be generated post-embryonically by neuroblast ALad1 (Yu et al., 2010). The axons of these neurons innervate a small area at the ventroposterior edge of the lateral horn. There are around two of these per hemisphere and they fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract and they are cholinergic (Bates et al., 2020).
